verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at policy: Expensify says users can 'build rules' when configuring workspaces via its AI assistant, and it offers 'Smart Limits' on cards, which suggests some spend controls and rule configuration. Nothing describes per-category, per-role, or context-based limits, or an auto-approval flow that routes only exceptions to a human. Missing for 10: documented category/role/context policy limits, auto-approval of in-policy expenses, exception-only routing to approvers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
